Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: technical deep-dive (post-discovery)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier this week — the team found it really helpful. We'd like to move to a technical deep-dive to validate integration assumptions and confirm SLO/latency constraints before procurement.

Attendees on our side: myself (product), their infra lead (Asha Patel, eng-ops@latticehealth.com), and one security reviewer who may drop in for the first 30 minutes.

Can you propose 60–90 minute slots next week (PST preferred)? Top items we'd like to cover: model routing/fallbacks, KV cache and prefix behavior, VPC connectivity options, data retention and audit logging. If you have a short precall checklist we can fill out it would speed things up.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Kapoor
Head of Product — Lattice Health
samir.kapoor@latticehealth.com

Hi Samir — great to hear. Happy to run the deep-dive. I've proposed an agenda below and attached a short precall checklist (redwood-precall-checklist.pdf) to capture traffic profile + network info ahead of time. That checklist really helps our infra engineers prepare targeted demos rather than general slides.

Proposed agenda (60–90 min):
- 5m: intros & objectives
- 15m: high-level architecture mapping (your infra + expected traffic patterns)
- 25m: runtime deep-dive (routing, batching, KV cache, quantization trade-offs)
- 10m: networking & private deployment options (VPC peering, private control plane)
- 10m: security/compliance & audit log expectations
- 10m: open Q&A, next steps / mutual action items

Suggested slots (PST):
- Mon 11/23 10:00–11:30
- Tue 11/24 14:00–15:30
- Thu 11/26 08:30–10:00

If none of those work we can slide into Friday morning. Please let me know which slot works and whether you prefer a 60 or 90 minute cadence.

Meeting format: screen-sharing and a lightweight runbook demo (we'll hand off to an engineer for the live run). If you can complete the attached checklist and optionally drop sample request/response sizes (even a small CSV) that would be ideal.

Attaching: redwood-precall-checklist.pdf (stub)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
